tagline: Oaxaca's surf capital — coastal Experiences and the bioluminescent Manialtepec lagoon.
summary: Puerto Escondido is Oaxaca's famous surf town, and while its beaches are surf-access, it carries a real Experiences waterborne market: dolphin and turtle boat trips from Playa Principal and the bioluminescent Laguna de Manialtepec ~18 km west. For scheduled transit, the genuine Oaxaca-coast node is nearby Huatulco (see separate brief). Here the fit is premium coastal and lagoon Experiences.

competitive_landscape: Lancha cooperatives run tours; no premium scheduled tier exists.
seasonality: Pacific hurricane season (Jun–Nov); the coast has strong surf swell year-round (a routing consideration).
regulatory_note: Mexican jurisdiction: API/Capitanía de Puerto (SEMAR); Manialtepec is an ecologically sensitive lagoon.
